newsitem.title: UK: Scholl buys Scholl Latin America.
newsitem.headline: Scholl buys Scholl Latin America.

text.p: British personal care products and footwear manufacturer Scholl Plc said on Thursday it had bought Scholl Latin America Ltd (SLA) and its subsidiary companies.
Under the terms of the deal, Scholl said it would pay an initial $12.5 million and make deferred payments of up to $5.25 million in each of the next two years depending on SLA's sales and profits.
Scholl said SLA's net assets totalled $3.0 million at the end of 1996. Operating profit totalled $1.35 million. It said it expected the acquisition to boost earnings.
